title: A teacher from the Faculty of Russian Philology is participating in an internship in Moscow

blocks.text: Aigerim Suyumbek kyzy, a lecturer at the Department of Theory and History of Russian Literature at the Faculty of Russian Philology, is undergoing an internship at the A.S. Pushkin State Institute of the Russian Language in Moscow as part of the InteRussia program.

The program is aimed at improving the qualifications of specialists in the field of Russian language and literature, as well as developing professional ties and exchanging experience between countries.
Participation in the program opens new horizons for teaching, research and international cooperation.
